events.event_hazard: Rising sea temperatures causing coral bleaching (marine heat)
key_impacts: Reef observed highly distressed due to elevated water temperatures
Widespread bleaching of staghorn coral reported
Coral health impacted by marine heat
evidence_snippets: In February this year... to see first-hand the impact that rising water temperatures were having on the health of the Reef.
[We] witnessed... a highly distressed reef, all but covered in... bleached-white staghorn coral.

events.event_hazard: Tropical Cyclone Debbie and associated flooding
key_impacts: Sediment flows onto the Reef following flooding
Coral and sea grass harmed by restricted light from sediment
evidence_snippets: A month later Cyclone Debbie did hit...
[It] caused widespread flooding in erosion hotspots causing sediment flows onto the Reef, which harm coral and sea grass.
missing_information: Specific inland flooded locations not named
